label: Pool Room
literalRoomDescription: This is a large room, one half of which is depressed. Salty water flows from a large leak in the ceiling. The only exit is to the west.
safeSceneProfile: Half-depressed floor, separate ceiling leak and salty pool. Hidden candy must not become a visible floor sparkle through opaque water.

sourceText: A stoppered glass flask with a skull-and-crossbones marking is here. The flask is filled with some clear liquid.
There is a skull-and-crossbones engraved on the glass.
